title: Notice of Rent Adjustment & Lease Renewal
urgency_reason: The tenant must respond by October 31, 2026, or the lease will automatically renew at a higher rent.
summary: This is a notice from the property management company informing the tenant that their rent will increase from $1,250.00 to $1,395.00 per month, effective January 1, 2026. The lease will automatically renew on a month-to-month basis unless the tenant declines the new terms by October 31, 2026. The security deposit will also be increased by $145.00 to match the new rent.
eli5: The landlord is raising the rent and will keep you as a tenant unless you tell them by a certain date that you don't want to stay at the new price.

deadlines.consequence: Failure to respond results in automatic lease renewal at the new rent and security deposit.

red_flags.why: The lease renews automatically unless the tenant takes action, which can lead to unintended rent increases.
The tenant must act by a specific date to avoid renewal, which may be missed if not noticed.

signals: Official letterhead and verifiable reference number

checklist.detail: Understand the new rent, security deposit, and the deadline to respond.

checklist.step: Decide whether to accept the new terms
checklist.detail: Consider if the rent increase is fair and if you want to continue renting.
If you do not want to renew, send a written notice to the property manager by October 31, 2026.

checklist.step: Keep a copy of your response
checklist.detail: Save a record of your communication in case of disputes.

raw_text:
HARBOURVIEW PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LLC
88 Dockside Ave, Suite 4 • Maplewood, ST 04110
NOTICE OF RENT ADJUSTMENT & LEASE RENEWAL
Date: 09/14/2026 Unit: 4B
Tenant: A. RENTER Lease ends: 11/30/2026
Dear Tenant,

Pursuant to Section 8.2 of your lease agreement, this letter serves as notice that effective 12/01/2026, the monthly rent for Unit 4B will increase from $1,250.00 to $1,395.00 (an 11.6% adjustment), reflecting current market rates and building operating costs.

Your renewed lease will convert to a month-to-month term with a 60-day termination notice clause, and the security deposit will be topped up by $145.00 to match the new rent.

If you wish to decline renewal and vacate, written notice must be received no later than 10/31/2026. Failure to respond by that date constitutes acceptance of all new terms.

Note: per city ordinance 7.55, rent increases above 10% require 90 days advance notice and registration with the Rental Board.

RESPOND BY 10/31/2026

Signed: M. Castellanos, Property Manager
